name: armoriq
description: ArmorIQ V5 compact-SaaS design system component manifest.

components.name: Button
components.summary: The canonical button primitive that replaces 367 ad-hoc <button> sites with one variant + size + icon-slot component.

props.name: variant
props.type: primary | secondary | tertiary | ghost | danger | dangerSoft

props.name: iconOnly
props.description: Hides the label, makes the button square; children becomes aria-label.

props.name: loading
props.description: Swaps the leading slot for a spinner and disables interaction.

props.name: children
props.description: Visible label; with iconOnly it is read as the aria-label.

components.usage: Use variant=primary for the one main action per view; secondary for outline; tertiary/ghost for low-emphasis; danger/dangerSoft for destructive. Use iconOnly for tight chrome rows and loading for in-flight submits.
components.whenToReachFor: Any clickable action. Never a raw <button> in feature code.

components.name: Chip
components.summary: The canonical chip that unifies passive label chips, active filter chips, and status pills (tone x selected x removable, optional leading icon).

props.name: tone
props.type: neutral | accent | good | warn | bad | info

props.name: onClick
props.description: When provided, the chip renders as a button.

props.name: onRemove
props.description: Fires on trailing x click; required when removable.

components.usage: Use for filter chips, role/level/status labels, and any small rounded-full tag. Set selected for active filters and removable+onRemove for dismissible filters.
components.whenToReachFor: You need a small rounded pill/tag/filter token instead of hand-rolling a rounded-full border px-2 span.

components.name: FormField
components.summary: Wraps a form control with a label, optional required mark, and helper text that swaps to an error message (with a one-time shake) when an error is set.

props.name: helper
props.description: Helper text shown when error is unset.

props.name: error
props.description: Error message; replaces helper and red-tints the field.

props.name: htmlFor
props.description: Explicit id for the control inside children.

variantClasses.label: text-aq-ink-soft text-aq-xs inline-flex items-center gap-1 font-medium

components.usage: Wrap an input/select/textarea to get a consistent label + helper/error block; pass error to switch the helper line to an error and trigger a shake.
components.whenToReachFor: Any labeled form control that needs helper text and/or validation error display.

components.name: SearchField
components.summary: A controlled search-styled text input with a leading magnifier icon and a trailing clear (x) button that appears when there is a value.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the next string value.

variantClasses.wrapper: border-aq-border bg-aq-surface flex h-9 items-center gap-2 rounded-md border px-3 focus-within:border-aq-accent transition-colors

components.usage: Use as a controlled filter input in list toolbars, filter popovers, and search-as-you-type panels; the owning route holds value/onChange.
components.whenToReachFor: A user filters a list by typing a search query.

components.name: StatusBadge
components.summary: A small status pill (tone + optional icon + label, optional shimmer) that conveys status as color plus icon plus label, never color alone.

props.name: tone
props.type: good | warn | bad | info | neutral | accent

props.name: shimmer
props.description: Shimmers the label for in-progress states.

variantClasses.base: text-aq-caption inline-flex items-center gap-1 self-start px-2 py-0.5 font-semibold

components.usage: Use to show a policy/enforcement/validation state as a colored pill with an icon and label.
components.whenToReachFor: A row or card needs a compact colored status indicator with a label.

components.name: StatusChip
components.summary: A bottom-center confirmation toast chip (tone icon, optional action, optional dismiss) that appears after an important action lands, with a useStatusChip() hook to drive it.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Renders a Dismiss button when provided.

variantClasses.base: border-aq-toast-border bg-aq-toast-bg text-aq-toast-fg shadow-aq-modal pointer-events-auto flex items-center gap-2.5 rounded-lg border px-4 py-2.5

components.usage: Use via useStatusChip() to show a transient 'this happened' confirmation after a Save/Confirm/Apply, optionally with an Undo action; drop {chip.element} in the route and call chip.show(msg).
components.whenToReachFor: An action lands and you want a brief bottom-center confirmation instead of an interstitial modal.

components.name: Banner
components.summary: An inline informational strip with a tone-tinted background, leading icon, message, and optional action and dismiss button.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Renders a trailing x dismiss when provided.

variantClasses.base: flex items-center gap-2.5 rounded-md border px-3.5 py-2.5

components.usage: Use for an inline, full-width tinted notice (read-only mode, errors, draft-restored) optionally with an action and dismiss.
components.whenToReachFor: You need a persistent inline status/notice strip at the top of a section or form.

components.name: SettingCard
components.summary: A Vercel-style account-settings card with a header (title + optional description), a body control, and an optional tinted footer-bar carrying helper text and a state-driven Save button.

props.name: title
props.description: Card title, always rendered in the header.

props.name: saveState
props.description: Drives the Save button; ignored when immediate is true.

props.name: onSave
props.description: Called when the Save button is clicked.

props.name: immediate
props.description: When true, the footer-bar is omitted (no Save button).

props.name: helperText
props.description: Helper text shown in the footer-bar's left slot.

props.name: error
props.description: Inline error displayed below the body; Save stays dirty to retry.

variantClasses.root: bg-aq-surface border-aq-border relative overflow-hidden rounded-lg border
variantClasses.footer: border-aq-border bg-aq-zebra flex items-center justify-between gap-3 border-t px-5 py-3

components.usage: Render one per individual setting on the /account page; put the control in children, wire saveState/onSave, and set immediate for controls that take effect on change. Use tone=danger for destructive settings and tone=ssomanaged for SSO-locked read-only ones.
components.whenToReachFor: You need a single, self-contained account/settings setting with its own Save affordance and dirty/saving/success/error feedback.

components.name: Tabs
components.summary: A horizontal, page-level tab strip under a hairline with a spring-animated 2px accent underline indicator and optional per-tab count badges.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the next tab key on click.

props.name: items
props.description: Tabs in display order; TabItem = { key, label, icon?, count?, danger? }.

variantClasses.tab: text-aq-sm hover:bg-aq-accent-soft relative inline-flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md px-3 py-1.5 font-medium transition-colors
variantClasses.count: bg-aq-zebra text-aq-ink-muted text-aq-caption ml-0.5 rounded-full px-1.5 py-0.5 font-semibold tabular-nums

components.usage: Use for object-detail pages with a 'header + tabbed body' layout (e.g. member detail); pair with a ?tab= query param for deep-linkable URL-synced tabs.
components.whenToReachFor: You need a horizontal page-level tab strip with an animated underline (between vertical TabRail and compact SegmentedControl).

components.name: TabRail
components.summary: A vertical tab rail for left-side in-page navigation, where the active row gets an accent-soft wash, accent-strong bold text, and a 2px spring-animated accent strip on its left edge.

props.name: value
props.description: Active item key; must match an items[].key.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the next key when a row is picked.

props.name: items
props.description: Rows in display order; TabRailItem = { key, label, icon? }.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible label for the nav region.

variantClasses.row: text-aq-sm relative flex w-full cursor-pointer items-center gap-2.5 rounded-md px-3 py-2 text-left
variantClasses.strip: bg-aq-accent absolute top-1 bottom-1 left-0 w-0.5 rounded-full

components.usage: Use for 'single page, left nav, right detail' surfaces such as the /account settings layout; supply ordered items and sync value/onChange.
components.whenToReachFor: You need a vertical in-page left-nav rail with an animated active-edge strip (rather than a horizontal tab strip).

components.name: SegmentedControl
components.summary: A compact, rounded radiogroup pill-strip for mutually exclusive choices, where the active segment is marked by a spring-animated lifted surface pill with a card shadow.

props.name: value
props.description: Current selected value (matches one of options[].value).

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the next value when a segment is picked.

props.name: options
props.description: Options in display order; SegmentedOption = { value, label, icon? }.

props.name: size
props.description: md adds a touch more horizontal padding.

variantClasses.group: bg-aq-zebra border-aq-border inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 rounded-md border p-0.5
variantClasses.segment: text-aq-xs relative inline-flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md font-medium

components.usage: Use for picker-style controls in dense surfaces (theme system/light/dark, density comfortable/compact, MFA method); fits next to a card title.
components.whenToReachFor: You need a small, self-contained 'pick one of a few' segmented pill control inline in a dense surface.

components.name: Menu
components.summary: Overflow-menu primitives: <Menu> is a vertical container (pair with <Popover> for anchoring) and <MenuItem> is a single actionable row with icon, shortcut, and default/danger tones.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Menu: ARIA label when the menu has no visible heading.

props.name: tone
props.description: MenuItem: tone; danger red-tints destructive items.

variantClasses.item: text-aq-sm flex w-full items-center gap-2.5 rounded-md px-2.5 py-1.5 text-left font-medium transition-colors
variantClasses.container: border-aq-border bg-aq-surface shadow-aq-popover flex flex-col gap-0.5 rounded-md border p-1

components.usage: Compose <MenuItem> children inside <Menu> and anchor it with <Popover> for overflow/kebab menus. Use tone=danger for destructive actions and shortcut for keyboard hints.
components.whenToReachFor: You need a dropdown/overflow action menu of clickable items (with optional icons, shortcuts, and a destructive variant).

components.name: Modal
components.summary: A centered overlay dialog (portal-rendered, Esc/backdrop close, body-scroll lock) for confirmations and short focused flows.

props.name: title
props.description: Heading text shown in the header.

props.name: tone
props.description: Accepted for API stability; tone is conveyed by footer actions.

props.name: icon
props.description: Accepted for API stability; not rendered in the simplified header.

props.name: footer
props.description: Action row rendered in the footer.

variantClasses.panel: bg-aq-surface shadow-aq-modal relative flex max-h-[90vh] w-full flex-col rounded-xl
variantClasses.close: text-aq-ink-muted hover:bg-aq-zebra hover:text-aq-ink absolute top-3 right-3 flex h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-md
variantClasses.title: text-aq-md m-0 font-bold
variantClasses.footer: flex justify-end gap-2 px-6 pt-2 pb-5

components.usage: Use for centered confirmation/short-flow dialogs (transfer ownership, delete confirms); place actions in the footer via ModalPrimaryButton/ModalSecondaryButton.
components.whenToReachFor: You need a centered, focused confirmation or short modal flow rather than a side drawer.

components.name: SideModal
components.summary: A Notion-style right-side drawer (portal-rendered, Esc/backdrop close, body-scroll lock) for peek detail views with an optional 'Open as page' promotion.

props.name: open
props.description: Controls visibility; when false nothing is rendered.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Called on X, backdrop click, or Esc.

props.name: title
props.description: Heading at the top of the drawer.

props.name: onOpenFullPage
props.description: When provided, renders an 'Open as page' button to promote the peek to a full-page route.

variantClasses.panel: bg-aq-surface border-aq-border shadow-aq-modal relative flex h-full flex-col border-l
variantClasses.header: border-aq-border flex items-center gap-3 border-b px-5 py-3.5
variantClasses.title: text-aq-md flex-1 truncate font-bold
variantClasses.openAsPage: text-aq-ink-soft hover:bg-aq-zebra text-aq-sm flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md px-2 py-1 font-medium
variantClasses.close: text-aq-ink-soft hover:bg-aq-zebra flex h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-md

components.usage: Use for 'peek' detail views (an agent row, an MCP server) where the surrounding registry context stays useful; pass onOpenFullPage to allow promotion to the detail route.
components.whenToReachFor: You want to inspect an item's details in a slide-in drawer without leaving the current list/registry context.

components.name: Toggle
components.summary: An accessible pill switch rendered as a real <button role='switch'>, with a track that recolors on checked and a knob that slides 150ms (motion-safe).

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the next state when toggled.

props.name: size
props.description: sm: 32x18 track/14px knob; md: 38x22 track/16px knob.

variantClasses.track: relative inline-flex shrink-0 cursor-pointer items-center rounded-full
variantClasses.knob: bg-aq-surface shadow-aq-card absolute rounded-full motion-safe:transition-[left] motion-safe:duration-150

components.usage: Use for on/off settings; pass checked/onChange, choose size=sm for dense rows and md for card bodies, and always supply ariaLabel.
components.whenToReachFor: You need an accessible boolean on/off switch.

components.name: ListRow
components.summary: The canonical row primitive for vertical item stacks, with leading/trailing slots, title/meta text, density control, and optional click-to-interactive behavior.

props.name: onClick
props.description: When provided, the row becomes interactive (hover + trailing chevron).

props.name: asCard
props.description: Render as a card (own border + radius) vs inside a parent bordered list.

components.usage: Use for any vertical stack of list items (join requests, sessions, devices, workspaces); set asCard={false} when rows sit inside a shared bordered container, and pass onClick to make the row navigate.
components.whenToReachFor: You are rendering a list/stack of items each with a title, optional meta, and leading/trailing content.

components.name: SectionHeader
components.summary: A content-block header with a colored tone icon chip, title, optional count pill, and optional trailing action link.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon rendered in the tone-colored chip.

props.name: tone
props.type: accent | good | warn | bad | info | neutral
props.description: Color tone of the icon chip.

props.name: count
props.description: Numeric count rendered as a small pill; omit to hide.

props.name: action
props.description: Trailing action label; omit to hide.

components.usage: Use to head a logical block of content (Relationships groups, Roles distribution, Access section) with an icon, title, count, and optional 'View all' style action.
components.whenToReachFor: You need a labeled section heading with an optional count and a trailing action affordance.

components.name: Stepper
components.summary: A horizontal sequence of wizard steps where each step is done / current / upcoming based on currentIndex.

props.name: currentIndex
props.description: 0-based index; steps before are done, at index is current, after is upcoming.

variantClasses.circle.base: text-aq-caption flex h-5 w-5 items-center justify-center rounded-full border font-mono font-bold

components.usage: Use as a progress strip inside multi-step wizards (Create Team, Add Agent, onboarding) by passing the step list and the active currentIndex.
components.whenToReachFor: You are building a multi-step wizard and need a horizontal progress indicator.

components.name: Breadcrumb
components.summary: A horizontal chain of route crumbs where each crumb is static text, a navigating button, or a dropdown trigger, with the active crumb emphasized.

props.name: items
props.description: Crumbs; BreadcrumbItem = { key, label, onClick?, hasDropdown?, active? }.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes on the nav wrapper.

components.usage: Use to show the current route's location as a chain of crumbs (as in DashboardShell), wiring onClick for navigable crumbs and hasDropdown for sibling-route menus.
components.whenToReachFor: You need a route-location breadcrumb trail, optionally with navigable or dropdown crumbs.

components.name: PageState
components.summary: An empty/loading/error/denied state card with an icon disc, headline, optional body, and optional CTA, with a staggered reveal animation.

props.name: state
props.description: Which state the card represents; drives default icon and chip color.

props.name: icon
props.description: Override the default icon for this state.

components.usage: Drop in as the body of a page or section when there is nothing to render or a fetch is loading/failed/forbidden; pass a headline and optional body/CTA, optionally overriding the icon.
components.whenToReachFor: A screen needs a centered empty/loading/error/access-denied placeholder instead of hand-rolling a state card.

components.name: Tooltip
components.summary: A hover/focus hint that portals to <body> and positions itself above (or flips below) a single trigger child, fading and scaling in after a delay.

props.name: label
props.description: Tooltip text; when empty the trigger renders with no tooltip.

props.name: children
props.description: The trigger element (a single focusable child).

props.name: placement
props.description: Preferred side; flips when it would clip.

variantClasses.tip: bg-aq-ink text-aq-surface text-aq-caption shadow-aq-popover pointer-events-none fixed z-[70] max-w-[240px] rounded-md px-2 py-1 font-medium

components.usage: Wrap any focusable element to attach a short hover/focus hint; keep the label brief since it is width-capped at 240px.
components.whenToReachFor: An icon button or truncated label needs a short explanatory hint on hover/focus.

components.name: Avatar
components.summary: A person avatar that renders a deterministic image keyed by email/name and falls back to a colored initials disc on load failure, with an optional hover lift.

props.name: email
props.description: Hash seed for the image URL; preferred over name.

props.name: name
props.description: Display name used for alt text and initials fallback.

props.name: lift
props.description: Adds a subtle hover lift (for avatar rows/stacks).

components.usage: Use anywhere a person appears (owner columns, activity feed, audit log, comment threads); pass email (preferred) or name so the same user always renders consistently.
components.whenToReachFor: You need a user profile picture with a reliable initials fallback.

components.name: OrgAvatar
components.summary: A colored square brand mark showing an organization's initials, with a token-bound background color and size-derived corner radius.

props.name: org
props.type: { initials: string; color: accent | info | good | warn }
props.description: The org's initials and color family.

props.name: radius
props.description: Override the corner radius in px.

components.usage: Use in the org picker, join-request screens, invite acceptance, and the org switcher anywhere an org needs a tiny brand mark; pass { initials, color }.
components.whenToReachFor: You need a small colored org identity square (initials) rather than a person's avatar.

components.name: Popover
components.summary: An accessible anchor-relative overlay that portals to <body>, positions itself at a placement relative to an anchorRef, and closes on Esc/outside-click with focus management.

props.name: open
props.description: Controls visibility; when false nothing is rendered.

props.name: anchorRef
props.description: The element the popover anchors to.

props.name: placement
props.description: Where the panel sits relative to the anchor.

props.name: width
props.description: Fixed panel width in px (else sizes to content).

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessibility label for the panel container.

variantClasses.panel: bg-aq-surface border-aq-border shadow-aq-popover fixed z-50 rounded-lg border outline-none

components.usage: Use for dropdown-style overlays anchored to a trigger (account menu, notifications, role switcher) where a full modal would be too heavy; control open yourself and pass the trigger's ref as anchorRef.
components.whenToReachFor: You need a positioned, dismissible dropdown/panel attached to an on-page anchor element.

components.name: ViewToggle
components.summary: Icon-only two-segment toggle (grid + list) for switching a registry between card-grid and list/table views.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the next view when a segment is picked.

components.usage: Drop next to a list page's 'Add' CTA to flip between grid and list layouts; controlled, so the route owns the ViewMode state.
components.whenToReachFor: You need a compact, label-less grid-vs-list switch where horizontal room is tight.

components.name: SortControl
components.summary: Compact 'Sort: {key}' dropdown plus an asc/desc direction toggle for list pages.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the next key or direction.

components.usage: Place inside a ListToolbar's left control group; presentational/controlled, the route does the actual comparison. Reuses Popover + MenuItem for the key menu.
components.whenToReachFor: A list needs a user-pickable sort key with an ascending/descending flip.

components.name: ListToolbar
components.summary: The single unified controls row (tabs + filter + sort + search + count + view toggle + active-filter chips) for every list/registry/table page, in standard or ghost presentation.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual presentation; ghost docks an icon trio beside the tab strip.

props.name: ghostScale
props.description: Ghost-trio size; lg reads heavier to balance a tab strip.

props.name: tabs
props.description: First-class tab strip { items, value, onChange, ariaLabel? }.

props.name: filter
props.description: Filter facets + toggles { facets, toggles?, onClearAll }.

props.name: search
props.description: Search field state { value, onChange, placeholder? }.

props.name: view
props.description: Grid/list view toggle state { value, onChange, ariaLabel? }.

props.name: count
props.description: 'N of M' count display { shown, total, noun? }.

props.name: trailing
props.description: Page-specific controls pinned right, before the view toggle.

components.usage: Compose it as the controls row above any collection; it is presentational and controlled (the route owns tab/filter/search/sort/view state and does the filtering). Active-filter chips auto-render on a thin row beneath when set.
components.whenToReachFor: Any list/table/registry page needs its standard filter/sort/search/view header instead of ad-hoc chip rows or one-off controls.

components.name: TabToolbar
components.summary: Thin preset over ListToolbar locked to the ghost presentation at lg scale, giving the standard 'tab strip + ghost control trio' collection-page header.

props.name: ...props
props.description: Every ListToolbar prop except variant/ghostScale, which are fixed; pass tabs for the left strip and the rest forwards through.

components.usage: Use it instead of ListToolbar on standard collection pages (Plans, Agents, MCP, Policies) so every page gets the identical tab+trio shape without re-deciding variant/ghostScale.
components.whenToReachFor: A collection page wants the canonical tab-led header and you don't want to hand-tune ListToolbar's ghost knobs.

components.name: OTPInput
components.summary: Boxed one-digit-per-cell input for short codes (default 6 boxes), with auto-tab, paste distribution, and an error shake.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fires on any box change with the joined string.

props.name: onComplete
props.description: Fires when every box is filled.

props.name: error
props.description: Visual error state; boxes go border-aq-bad and the row shakes.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Focus the first empty box on mount.

components.usage: Use on auth/verify, MFA challenge, and reset flows; controlled (parent owns the value string) with auto-tab and full-string paste support.
components.whenToReachFor: You need a one-time-code / PIN entry split into per-digit cells.

components.name: PasswordStrengthMeter
components.summary: Subtle one-line password strength bar (0-100% fill) with a right-aligned Weak/Okay/Good/Strong label; renders nothing while the password is empty.
components.usage: Place directly under a password field on signup/reset; it self-scores and stays hidden until the user starts typing. Scoring is reusable via the co-exported scorePassword.
components.whenToReachFor: A new-password field needs a calm, inline strength indicator.

components.name: Collapsible
components.summary: Height-tweens a region open/closed (auto to 0) with overflow clipped, honoring prefers-reduced-motion.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes on the animated wrapper.

components.usage: Wrap expand/collapse rows, 'show more' sections, and accordion bodies so the container grows smoothly instead of jumping.
components.whenToReachFor: Content needs to expand/collapse with a smooth height animation rather than an instant show/hide.

components.name: UploadTarget
components.summary: A clickable avatar (image or initials-disc fallback) with a hover upload overlay and hidden image-only file input.

props.name: src
props.description: Current image URL; absent shows the initials fallback.

props.name: name
props.description: Display name used for initials + alt text.

props.name: onUpload
props.description: Fires when the user picks a file (forwards only; parent stores/previews).

props.name: helperText
props.description: Small caption shown to the right of the avatar.

components.usage: Use on a Profile card to let a user swap their portrait; click anywhere on the avatar opens an image-only picker and onUpload(file) fires.
components.whenToReachFor: A screen needs an avatar that doubles as an image-upload affordance.

components.name: GradientButton
components.summary: The single 'AI authoring' button, distinguished by the system's only gradient (aq-ai-from to aq-ai-to) with a loading spinner.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows spinner, sets aria-busy, disables interaction.

components.usage: Use exclusively for AI affordances (policy intent AI row, PolicyStudio header); forwardRef'd. The gradient is reserved for AI and used nowhere else.
components.whenToReachFor: An action invokes AI generation/authoring and should read as the system's one distinct AI button.

components.name: BrandIcon
components.summary: Renders a provider/tool logo from iconify's simple-icons, falling back to a 2-letter neutral square on load failure.

props.name: fallback
props.description: Letters shown in the fallback square.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes on the wrapper span.

components.usage: Use wherever an MCP server, OAuth provider, or third-party tool logo appears in lists/cards; a bad slug degrades to initials instead of breaking layout.
components.whenToReachFor: You need a third-party brand/provider logo by slug with a safe fallback.

components.name: SandboxPill
components.summary: Tiny pill surfacing an org's mode: 'Demo' (sandbox) or spinning 'Activating' in info tone; renders nothing for production.
components.usage: Drop into chrome (org switcher/header) to flag a sandbox/demo or activating org; controlled by mode and silently hides in production.
components.whenToReachFor: You need to badge an org/environment as demo or activating without cluttering production.

components.name: DesktopRecommendedBanner
components.summary: A 'best on desktop' advisory banner shown on authoring/dense screens when viewed below the lg breakpoint.
components.usage: Render at the top of authoring or dense table screens to advise users that the experience is best on a desktop viewport.
components.whenToReachFor: An authoring/dense screen is being used on a small viewport and needs a 'best on desktop' advisory. See source.

components.name: Loader
components.summary: There is no standalone Loader component; the canonical loader primitive is MatrixLoader, an animated 5x5 dot-matrix indicator in brand orange. (The Loader/ folder holds only a preview HTML.)
components.usage: Use as the in-app loading/processing indicator (import MatrixLoader); color inherits via currentColor for light+dark. This entry exists because the spec lists 'Loader' as a name; it resolves to MatrixLoader.
components.whenToReachFor: You need a branded loading/processing animation rather than a plain spinner. Use MatrixLoader.

components.name: CommandPalette
components.summary: A centered, portal-rendered modal overlay shell for global search / command surfaces that the caller fills with an input row and a scrollable result list. Complex / see source.

props.name: open
props.description: Controls visibility; renders nothing when false.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Called on dismiss (Esc or backdrop click).

components.usage: Wrap a controlled command surface; it owns backdrop dimming, Esc-to-close, body scroll lock, and portal rendering, while the caller supplies the input and result list and their keyboard nav.
components.whenToReachFor: Build any global search / command-K style palette. Complex / see source.

components.name: GraphNode
components.summary: A presentation-only, fully-parameterised circular graph-node body (ring, glyph, optional status dot / governance crown / count badge, two-line label) shared by the AIQ graph and the Plans flow canvas. Complex / see source.

props.name: radius
props.description: Circle radius in px; drives all geometry.

props.name: glyph
props.description: Monoline glyph drawn into a 24x24 viewBox.

props.name: isHero
props.description: Hero nodes layer a soft colour wash on the white base.

props.name: governed
props.description: Draws the governance crown above the node.

props.name: dim
props.description: Dims node (outside blast radius / not in focus).

components.usage: Render inside a React Flow node component; the caller resolves all hue/token class strings from node-config and passes them in so no graph-domain types leak into the shape.
components.whenToReachFor: You need the canonical circular node body on a React Flow canvas. Complex / see source.

components.name: ProductTour
components.summary: A dependency-free, fully-controlled spotlight walkthrough that dims the page with aq-scrim panels, cuts a clickable hole over each step's [data-tour] anchor, and shows a tooltip card beside it. Complex / see source.

props.name: steps
props.description: Ordered tour steps (anchor, title, body, placement?, padding?, cta?, advanceOnAnchorClick?).

components.usage: Host owns open + stepIndex; pass steps whose anchors match data-tour attributes on real UI; the hole stays live so steps can ask the user to click a real button before advancing.
components.whenToReachFor: Build a guided first-run / feature walkthrough over live page elements. Complex / see source.

components.name: WelcomeDialog
components.summary: The first-run 'welcome aboard' portal dialog for a freshly provisioned owner, with Framer Motion choreography and a self-sequencing exit that fires its callback only after the exit animation completes. Complex / see source.

props.name: orgName
props.description: Workspace name for the greeting; falls back to 'Welcome to ArmorIQ'.

props.name: onTakeTour
props.description: Fires after exit animation when the user picks the tour.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Fires after exit animation on dismiss / explore-alone.

components.usage: Render once on first landing on Plans; the CTAs trigger the card's exit animation and the chosen callback fires on onExitComplete, so the welcome is fully gone before the tour spotlight animates in.
components.whenToReachFor: The one-time onboarding greeting that launches the guided tour. Complex / see source.

components.name: CanvasModal
components.summary: An almost-full-screen (92vw x 88vh) portal modal over a blurred scrim that hosts an infinite canvas passed as children, with an eyebrow/title header and optional right slot. Complex / see source.

props.name: headerRight
props.description: Right-aligned header slot (e.g. a status badge).

props.name: children
props.description: The canvas; fills the modal body.

components.usage: Wrap a Plans flow or Discovery topology canvas for its expanded full-screen view; Esc or backdrop click closes and body scroll locks while open.
components.whenToReachFor: Give an inline canvas a shared full-screen expanded mode. Complex / see source.

components.name: CanvasDetailCard
components.summary: A pinned detail panel absolutely positioned against the right edge of a relative canvas wrapper (outside the canvas transform, so it doesn't pan/zoom), with an icon/eyebrow/title header, scrollable body, and optional sticky footer. Complex / see source.

props.name: footer
props.description: Optional sticky footer (e.g. a primary action).

components.usage: Place inside the same relative wrapper as a canvas (inline or inside CanvasModal); shows node/element detail without moving with the graph.
components.whenToReachFor: Show a node's detail panel pinned to the edge of any canvas. Complex / see source.

components.name: IapCard
components.summary: The canonical Intent Approval Prompt review card: agent to tool to MCP header with risk pill and trust score, a mono key/value arguments grid, a policy verdict line, and an approve/reject action row (or a ledger line once decided). Complex / see source.

props.name: iap
props.description: The IAP data (id, agent, agentSlug?, tool, mcp, mcpSlug, risk, trustScore, arguments, riskNote).

props.name: verdict
props.description: Drives the action row vs ledger state.

props.name: evidenceRef
props.description: Ledger reference shown next to Approved/Denied.

components.usage: Single source of truth for rendering an IAP to a human reviewer; used in the intent-plans dashboard detail/peek and the onboarding live moment.
components.whenToReachFor: Anywhere an agent's tool-call intent must be reviewed and approved/rejected. Complex / see source.

components.name: MatrixLoader
components.summary: An animated 5x5 dot-matrix loading indicator in ArmorIQ brand orange with four motion patterns (wave / pulse / sweep / orbit) and three sizes, resolving colors from CSS variables for light and dark. Complex / see source.

props.name: pattern
props.description: Animation pattern (generic / analysis / AI thinking / data fetch).

components.usage: Drop in as a small inline loading/thinking indicator; pick the pattern to match the activity (e.g. sweep for AI processing, orbit for scanning). Color comes from CSS variables, not aq-* class utilities.
components.whenToReachFor: The branded loading glyph instead of a generic spinner. Complex / see source.

components.name: AnimatedNumber
components.summary: Pops a numeric value when it changes, blurring/sliding the old value out and the new one in (direction follows the delta), with a reduced-motion plain-swap fallback. Complex / see source.

props.name: value
props.description: The number to display; changing it triggers the pop.

props.name: format
props.description: Formats the number before display (e.g. toLocaleString).

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes on the wrapper span.

components.usage: Wrap a live count (unread, sandbox usage, decision totals) so updates feel alive rather than silently swapping. Uses motion tokens, no aq-* class colors.
components.whenToReachFor: Any frequently-updating numeric counter. Complex / see source.

components.name: TextSwap
components.summary: Swaps text content in place with a blurred up-and-down transition when text changes, with a reduced-motion crossfade fallback. Complex / see source.

props.name: text
props.description: Current text; changing it triggers the swap.

components.usage: Use for a label that mutates in place (a status word, a live 'x selected' count, a toggle caption). Uses motion tokens, no aq-* class colors.
components.whenToReachFor: A single in-place text label changes and should animate the change. Complex / see source.

components.name: IconSwap
components.summary: Cross-fades between two icons in the same fixed slot (outgoing blurs/scales out, incoming blurs/scales in), driven by a changing swapKey, with a reduced-motion plain swap. Complex / see source.

props.name: swapKey
props.description: Changing it re-runs the swap; keep stable while the icon is stable.

props.name: icon
props.description: The icon for the current state.

components.usage: Drive with a boolean/status string (e.g. copied ? 'done' : 'idle') to swap glyphs without layout shift, such as a copy-to-check affordance. Uses motion tokens, no aq-* class colors.
components.whenToReachFor: An icon toggles between two states in place. Complex / see source.

components.name: Shimmer
components.summary: A thin wrapper that sweeps a soft highlight across muted text on a loop (via the aq-text-shimmer utility) for in-progress / 'thinking' labels that should feel alive without a spinner. Complex / see source.
components.usage: Wrap a running/streaming status label (e.g. 'Runningâ€¦') so it pulses while work is in progress. The gradient/timing live in the aq-text-shimmer utility in globals.css.
components.whenToReachFor: An in-progress text label that should read as alive without a spinner. Complex / see source.

components.name: BottomSheet
components.summary: Mobile bottom sheet: grab-bar handle, optional title + sticky thumb-zone footer, internal scroll. Backdrop/handle/Esc to dismiss.
components.usage: The mobile counterpart to Modal/SideModal. Use below the lg breakpoint for sheet-style flows.
components.whenToReachFor: A bottom-anchored sheet on small screens. Pairs with SheetSection/SheetOption.

components.name: DataCard
components.summary: Mobile data card: optional icon tile, title/subtitle, top-right status slot, up to a few 2-up labelled fields, and a thumb-zone action row. Whole card is tappable.
components.usage: The mobile equivalent of a table row / signal card. Use DataCardList to stack them.
components.whenToReachFor: Showing a record as a card on small screens instead of a table row.
